question: A man covers distances of 100 km, 408 km, and 1460 km at the speeds of 20 km/hr, x km/hr, and 20 km/hr, respectively. If his average speed for the whole journey is 20 km/hr, then what is the value of x?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since overall Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time:

⇒ (D₁ + D₂ + D₃) ÷ 20 = (D₁ ÷ 20) + (D₂ ÷ x) + (D₃ ÷ 20)

⇒ (D₁ ÷ 20) + (D₂ ÷ 20) + (D₃ ÷ 20) = (D₁ ÷ 20) + (D₂ ÷ x) + (D₃ ÷ 20)

⇒ D₂ ÷ 20 = D₂ ÷ x ⇒ x = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distances: D₁ = 100 km, D₂ = 408 km, D₃ = 1460 km

Speeds: S₁ = 20 km/hr, S₂ = x km/hr, S₃ = 20 km/hr

Average speed = 20 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 100 + 408 + 1460 = 1968 km

⇒ Total Time = (100 ÷ 20) + (408 ÷ x) + (1460 ÷ 20)

⇒ Total Time = 5 + (408 ÷ x) + 73 = 78 + (408 ÷ x) hours

⇒ Average Speed = 1968 ÷ [78 + (408 ÷ x)]

⇒ 20 = 1968 ÷ [78 + (408 ÷ x)]

⇒ 78 + (408 ÷ x) = 1968 ÷ 20

⇒ 78 + (408 ÷ x) = 98.4

⇒ 408 ÷ x = 98.4 − 78 = 20.4

⇒ x = 408 ÷ 20.4 = 4080 ÷ 204 = 20

**∴ The correct answer is 20 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Concept

Average speed is the measure of the total distance traveled completely over the total time elapsed. It accounts for speed variations across the trip. Formula: Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Equal Distances Average Speed

When a person travels two equal parts of a journey at speeds x and y, the average speed for the whole journey reduces to exactly 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

For two objects moving in the same direction at speeds a and b (where a > b), their relative speed is (a − b). If they move in opposite directions, it is (a + b).
